plugins.name: Album filler
plugins.description: Finds the records you own most of and offers you the songs that are missing.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: EQ rack
plugins.description: A preset rack for the equalizer: save your own curves, flip between A and B, and land any of them in one tap.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Filters
plugins.description: A shelf of finished sounds: slowed, sped up, nightcore, lofi, vinyl, cathedral, night drive and two dozen more, each one tap away.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: HiFi Lab
plugins.description: Chain EQs, filters and dynamics into a signal path of your own — reorder the boxes, save the racks you build.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Karaoke Maker
plugins.description: Turn any song in your library into karaoke — the vocal lifted out, the words full screen, in time.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Looper
plugins.description: Sample any song into sixteen coloured pads, cut on its own beat, and play the pieces in time with each other.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Pads
plugins.description: A sampler you play with your thumbs — pull any song into vocals, drums, bass and everything else, chop them, and hit them.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Pedals
plugins.description: A pedalboard for your music: fifty-five stompboxes across drive, lo-fi, filter, modulation, time, space and dynamics, wired in the order you stack them.
plugins.author: AttackFM
